review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. Narrative with dialogue. The two-way prepositions (unter, neben, hinter) are used only with the dative of place in fixed, simple phrases (unter dem Bett, neben dem Tisch, hinter dem Stuhl). "Rucksack" is the usual word for a school bag (Schulranzen is the primary-school word and is left out). Ben loses things (a Stage 0 trait). Ben uses du with adults he knows well (Marta, Lukas, Thomas, Sam) and Sie with Herr Schmidt.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.english: It is half past seven.
Ben gets up.

sentences.text: Er hat kein Fieber, er ist gesund.
sentences.english: He has no fever, he is well.

sentences.text: Heute geht Ben wieder in die Schule.
sentences.english: Today Ben goes back to school.
But where is the school bag?
Ben looks for it.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Grandma, where is my school bag?

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: I do not know, Ben.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: You are always losing something!

sentences.text: Ben sucht unter dem Bett, neben dem Tisch und hinter dem Stuhl.
sentences.english: Ben looks under the bed, next to the table and behind the chair.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I cannot see it!

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Dein Schlüssel liegt auf dem Tisch.
sentences.english: Your key is on the table.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Dein Buch liegt unter dem Tisch, und deine Tasche ist neben dem Bett.
sentences.english: Your book is under the table, and your bag is next to the bed.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich brauche ihn, nicht die Tasche!
sentences.english: I need it, not the bag!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I cannot find it!

sentences.text: Es ist acht Uhr, und die Klasse fängt an.
sentences.english: It is eight o'clock, and the class begins.
Ben has no exercise book.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: Good morning, Ben!

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: Where is it?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I have lost it.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Du bist ein guter Schüler, aber du verlierst immer etwas.
sentences.english: You are a good pupil, but you are always losing something.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Er liegt nicht in der Klasse.
sentences.english: It is not in the classroom.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: What do we do?

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Der Stuhl steht hinter dem Tisch.
sentences.english: The chair is behind the table.

sentences.text: In der Pause sagt Ben: "Ich möchte ihn finden."
sentences.english: During the break Ben says: "I want to find it."

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Nach der Schule suchen wir ihn.
sentences.english: After school we will look for it.

sentences.text: Nach der Schule gehen Ben, Lukas und Sam in die Stadt.
sentences.english: After school Ben, Lukas and Sam go into the city.

sentences.text: Sam ist ein Freund von Ben.
sentences.english: Sam is a friend of Ben's.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich bin Student, ich habe eine Stunde.
sentences.english: I am a student, I have an hour.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I can help.

sentences.text: Sie gehen zu Herrn Schmidt in die Bäckerei.
sentences.english: They go to Herr Schmidt at the bakery.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Herr Schmidt, do you have it?

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.english: No, Ben.

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.text: Ich bin Bäcker und Chef von der Bäckerei, ich finde Brötchen.
sentences.english: I am a baker and the boss of the bakery, I find rolls.

sentences.text: Dann gehen sie in die Klinik.
sentences.english: Then they go to the clinic.

sentences.text: Anna ist Krankenschwester, und Michael ist Arzt.
sentences.english: Anna is a nurse, and Michael is a doctor.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.english: Ben, you are well!

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.english: That is nice.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.english: But I cannot see it.

sentences.speaker: michael
sentences.english: I see no school bag here.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Ihr habt alle einen guten Beruf, aber ihr habt ihn nicht.
sentences.english: You all have a good job, but you do not have it.
There is a man in the park.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Do you have it?

sentences.speaker: mann
sentences.english: No, not here.

sentences.text: Es ist warm, und die Sonne ist da.
sentences.english: It is warm, and the sun is out.
Ben is tired.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ben, am Sonntag bist du in der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: Ben, on Sunday you are at the church.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Is it at the church?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Yes, that is good!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Let us go!

sentences.text: Pastor Thomas ist in der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: Pastor Thomas is at the church.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: Hello, Ben!

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: Are you looking for it?

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Er steht hinter dem Stuhl, unter dem Fenster.
sentences.english: It is behind the chair, under the window.
And there it is!
Ben finds the school bag.

sentences.text: Das Heft liegt neben dem Rucksack.
sentences.english: The exercise book is lying next to the school bag.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Leg das Heft in den Rucksack, Ben!
sentences.english: Put the exercise book in the school bag, Ben!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: My exercise book is there too!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: Thank you, Thomas!

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.english: I do not want to lose it.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: Good, Ben.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: And tomorrow we are learning again.
